objective: Correct BUKLOD MAIN Wall post ownership actions end-to-end with media-safe video edits and private/public/delete confirmation on Android.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: inspected source branch main commit 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f on 2026-11-23; source is not an independently verified live OTA fingerprint.
chosenApproach: Route unchanged-media captions through owner-checked text RPC only; explicit photo replacement/clear through v7 transactional media RPC; one Android native Modal with serialized actions; scoped delete updates only local state.
selectionRationale: A text-only edit previously called media replacement with empty photos and silently nulled the legacy media reference, risking lost video playback; Android independent modals could overlap.

acceptanceChecks: Run new and existing focused Wall owner tests as part of engineering accountability.
Compile TypeScript and run compact layout, performance, recent-comment and ads navigation source QA.

Production OTA remains prohibited until verified staging RC, ads and nav gates pass.
alternativeApproaches: Always replace media on every caption edit (rejected: risks media deletion and expensive uploads).
Use separate native Alert and editor Modals (rejected: Android transition race).
Bypass backend RPC and directly write table columns (rejected: RLS can affect zero rows without error).
